description: This Java source file defines the class PaymentMethodServices, providing services related to payment methods such as creation, update, deletion, and expiration of various payment entities (CreditCard, GiftCard, EftAccount, CheckAccount). It contains methods for security checks, entity management, and handling payment data in the Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: PaymentMethodServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing various payment methods including credit cards, gift cards, EFT accounts, and check accounts within the Ofbiz framework. Methods handle creation, updating, deletion, expiration, and associated security checks.

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Deletes (expires) a payment method entity by setting its 'thruDate' to current timestamp, with security checks.

methods.name: makeExpireDate
methods.description: Generates an expiration date string in 'MM/YYYY' format from provided month and year.

methods.name: createCreditCard
methods.description: Creates new CreditCard and PaymentMethod entities with provided parameters, including validation and security permission checks.

methods.name: updateCreditCard
methods.description: Updates existing CreditCard and PaymentMethod entities with parameter validation and security checks.

methods.name: clearCreditCardData
methods.description: Clears sensitive credit card data, sets default placeholders, and expires the payment method.

methods.name: createGiftCard
methods.description: Creates new GiftCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateGiftCard
methods.description: Updates existing GiftCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: createEftAccount
methods.description: Creates EFT account and PaymentMethod entities with validation and security checks.

methods.name: updateEftAccount
methods.description: Updates EFT account and PaymentMethod entities, with validation and security.

methods.name: createCheckAccount
methods.description: Creates Check account and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateCheckAccount
methods.description: Updates Check account and PaymentMethod entities with validation and security.
